purpose: hidden near-duplicate audit of the Phase 3 distractor pool (docs/phase3_dataset_plan.md 8.4)

weights_licence.name: Apache License 2.0
evidence: README 'License' section of github.com/facebookresearch/dinov2: 'DINOv2 code and model weights are released under the Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE for additional details.'
LICENSE file of the same repository is the Apache License, Version 2.0, January 2004
weights_licence.scope_note: other models in that repository (XRay-DINO weights, Cell-DINO code) carry different terms and are not used

preprocessing: whole image resized to 224x224 bicubic, ImageNet mean/std, no crop

manual_checks_done.30_closest_pairs_overall: all 30 are flat colour-gradient images, not photographs (cosine 0.9990-1.0000)
manual_checks_done.10_closest_distractor_copydays_pairs: closest cosine 0.8618; all 10 are DIFFERENT photographs of similar scenes; no distractor is a copy of a Copydays original
manual_checks_done.12_non_flat_pairs_at_or_above_0.90: viewed after the fact; all different photographs of similar subjects (moon, star fields, stadiums, Grand Canyon, Taj Mahal, show jumping, hockey); the closest (0.946) is two frames from what appears to be one fixed camera at different times, a distinct image under the 'same scene, next frame' policy
manual_checks_done.not_inspected: pairs with cosine 0.85-0.90, and all pairs below 0.85

post_hoc_findings.label: POST-HOC and exploratory: the declared flag rule did not anticipate this; thresholds below were not pre-registered

flat_gradient_images.finding: a measurable share of the sampled 'distractors' are flat colour-gradient images, not photographs (near-identical tiny files, about 0.013 bytes/pixel)
flat_gradient_images.measure: detail energy = mean |gray - (16x16-area-resampled then bilinear-upsampled gray)|
flat_gradient_images.explains_flagged_pairs: 10,773 of the 10,785 flagged distractor pairs (cosine >= 0.90) have both images below 1.0

post_hoc_findings.consequence: such images are degenerate distractors: they look alike to DINOv2 and would produce many false positives for any similarity method, and are not natural-photo negatives
post_hoc_findings.action_taken: NONE. No file was deleted or edited. An exclusion rule (and resampling to restore 10,000) is a design decision for the Phase 3 design freeze

final_pool_audit.pool_manifest: phase3/manifests/distractor_pool.jsonl (10,000 images after the content-only exclusion; see distractor_pool.summary.json)

manual_checks_done.30_closest_pairs_overall: viewed; all different photographs of similar subjects (stadiums, hockey, Taj Mahal, waves, manuscripts, fireworks, concerts, swimming, space shuttle); the only next-frame cases are the fixed-camera cluster; one pair is two DIFFERENT Copydays originals (205800 and 207800, two views of the Verona arena, cosine 0.8959)
manual_checks_done.10_closest_distractor_copydays_pairs: sheet written; the initial-pool check (closest 0.8618) found different photographs; no distractor-Copydays pair reaches 0.90 in the final pool
manual_checks_done.band_0.85_0.90: seeded sample of 24 of 94 pairs (seed 12345) viewed: 0 duplicates; all different photographs of similar subjects, except 2 pairs (cosine 0.8729 and 0.8661) that appear to be fixed-camera frames. Not exhaustive: the other 70 band pairs and everything below 0.85 were not inspected

final_pool_audit.verdict: no pair reaches 0.95; 12 distractor pairs at or above 0.90, all previously viewed and none a duplicate; no distractor is a copy of a Copydays original
